atoms.text: Notwendige Relativsätze sind Nebensätze, die sich auf ein bereits erwähntes Nomen im Hauptsatz beziehen und dieses näher bestimmen. Man erkennt sie daran, dass ohne sie der Hauptsatz unvollständig wäre.

instruction.text: Ordne den Hauptsätzen die passenden notwendigen Relativsätze zu.

atoms.b: who is always in a good mood, which is why she is my best friend.
atoms.sound: Maya is a person who is always in a good mood, which is why she is my best friend.

atoms.b: that deal with modern day fairy tales.
atoms.sound: I really like books that deal with modern day fairy tales

atoms.a: Please call me if you find a pencil case
atoms.b: which is red, it might be mine.
atoms.sound: Please call me if you find a pencil case which is red, it might be mine.

instruction.text: Ordne den Relativpronomen ihre jeweilige Verwendung zu.

atoms.b: When I was in the park, I saw a Husky ((++that whose)) had the cutest blue eyes.
I've never seen myself as someone ((++who which)) is introverted.
I think I might have lost the money ((who ++which)) I was carrying in my handbag.
This is my neighbour ((who ++whose)) child I babysit from time to time.
